profile.headline: Software Engineer at Etsy
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
"Jack of all trades" with 6+ years of experience in data science, software engineering and AI. My specialty is learning new skills and concepts quickly, and bringing all my learnings to deliver impactful solutions. 

Proven ability to lead projects, build new features, and derive insights through technical research, analysis, and design thinking. Future aspirations for developing applications in various AI fields with particular interest in computer vision.

positions.title: Data Insights Consultant
positions.description: Focus on forming stories around clients' data; providing insights to their customers' behaviors and tendencies, and recommendations on how to best connect with their base.

positions.title: Data Science Immersive Program
positions.description:
Skilled in Python, Statistical Analysis, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning in this 15-week intensive training program. As part of the program I attended lectures, completed individual and group programming assignments, code challenges and projects to demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of both the theory and applications necessary to become a Data Science professional. 

• Studied a variety of data science tools in depth, including Python, SQL, scikit-learn, Pandas, Keras
• Worked individually and in teams to develop and present a variety of data science projects including:

Audio Speaker Recognition: Identifying which celebrity is speaking through deep neural networks
• Extracted 5 features from dataset of over 64,000 audio clips of ~530 celebrities to feed into neural network models
• Built 5 models; best model used 17 layers of CNN-selu and softmax output layer and achieved accuracy and F1-score of 0.73

Debunking Skin Motion Soundwave Tattoo: Recreated skin motion tattoo technology where an image/ tattoo can play back an audio sample using the Skin Motion app
• Collected audio samples, converted them to bytes and soundwave images, and extracted features to store in SQL database
• Queried database to compare stored soundwave image to new tattoo image in order to play back corresponding audio

Summary Analysis on College Basketball: Exploring the relationship between college basketball teams and coaches’ salaries
• Web-scraped over 100 college basketball sites and stored information in SQL database
• Queried database and visualized findings with Dash dashboards. Found correlation between salaries and performances

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Student Lead for the Summer Service Learning Program (SSLP) - Morocco. Led and guided a team of 5 Stanford students in assisting MCISE, a Moroccan NGO, with an education initiative. Main responsibility encompasses scaling, accessibility, technology, and sustainability while retaining quality. Deliverables included financial model outlining profitability, established long-term partnerships, created corporate packet, revamped website, impact assessments, alumni connections, and other sustainable ideas.

company.name: Moroccan Center For Innovation and Social Entrepreneurship

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description:
Assisted in the ongoing formation of CARE KC; an organization that envisions supporting efforts of siloed organizations in attaining race equity. Provided research for the founding team so that they may make informed decisions.

Worked with reStart Inc., a Kansas City agency whose mission is to end homelessness in Kansas City while serving all types of demographics. Project was centered around donor analysis - yielding insights in the data that informed the CEO & President about the current trend of donor attributes.

positions.title: Community Engaged Learning Coordinator
positions.description: CEL Coordinator for MS&E 188, Organizing for Good, through the Haas Center for Public Service. Main responsibility was to act as liaison between partnering organizations, the teaching team, and the student teams. Ensure effective and efficient collaboration, as well as a mutual learning experience for the organizations and the students.

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
Autumn Course: Educating Young STEM Thinkers is a Cardinal Course. Students enrolled in this class go to a middle school and mentor, teach and change students mindsets on STEM and their abilities and capabilities. 

Winter Course: Designing Modern Work Organizations

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Researched on three companies in the online education industry. Studied their strategies through frameworks such as VRIN resources, Porter's Five Force Analysis, and compared them to one another to look for patterns and certain trends.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked with the Laser Ignition Systems group supervised by Professor Ben Akih Kumgeh, specifically focusing on CFD simulations of a Laser-Induced Shockwave. Laser ignition is a more efficient way of starting a combustion process; igniting the fuel-air mixture at a leaner ratio. Products of laser ignition are plasma formation, shockwave propagation, and a fire kernel. Purpose of CFD modeling what occurs in experiments and other research is to create a basis. Changing different parameters in the simulation allows for efficiency in time and resources in analyzing, mimicking, and possibly predicting the behavior of a particular combustion process.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked mainly with excel, compiling data for multiple projects to be used by lead engineers. Assembled a reciprocating compressor, held couple of meetings, oversaw an NPCA, found solution to rain test failure of a terminal box, created 12 product bulletins for customer notification, and advanced the WPA – RoHS project.

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.issuer: Issued by College of Engineering · May 2016

honors.title: Student Choice Award
honors.description: Won Student Choice Awards for presenting my research at ULSAMP Leadership Conference

projects.title: Table Tennis Return System
projects.description: In a team of five, we were responsible for assessing risks when developing designs, consider real world applications, and regard time/cost efficiencies in order to build a catch and release system. This catch and release system would be able to receive projected ping pong balls, and launch it back at a specified location.

projects.title: Pure Quench: Portable Heated Water Purifier Kit
projects.description: A part of a team of four amongst four teams that were given a challenge and expected to create a product that fulfilled four criteria and the challenge's scenario. My team placed 2nd with our product "Pure Quench: Portable Heated Water Purifier Kit"; our product was a two part system that used floodwater's flow to generate power through a nozzle and store the energy in a battery. The battery is then used for thermal energy to boil the two-step filtering of the floodwater so that it may be safe for drinking.
